# Partial IPA positive-evidence data

The reviewed ledger records 170 selected symbol encodings, 18 literal chart
examples and nine exact Unicode 13 canonical-equivalence inputs. This is a
partial positive table. An unlisted input is unavailable evidence, never a
normative rejection. Even an attested example does not establish full IPA
sequence validity or intended pronunciation. No compatibility normalization is
performed.

The runtime JSON bundle is a projection of `positive-ledger.json`. Runtime
verification certifies these derived bytes and their approved lineage. It does
not assert that the historical chart or Unicode sources were read during that
run. The full ledger preserves original source URLs, hashes and row locators;
`mapping-aid-omissions.json` records omitted or ambiguous mapping-aid entries.
The 2026 mapping aid supplies explicit encoding identities, not normative
completeness of the 2015 chart.

This DATA is separately distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0, with the historical
